newsitem.title: USA: Teleport to use Cisco ATM switch.
newsitem.headline: Teleport to use Cisco ATM switch.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Wednesday that Teleport Communications Group Inc has agreed to incorporate Cisco's Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) switching equipment into Teleport's data services network.
Cisco said Teleport agreed to use the Cisco LightStream 1010 ATM switch as one of its switching platforms.
Teleport said it plans to install LightStream 1010 ATM switches in its central office equipment to provide customers with high-speed data communcations in most major markets.

Teleport operates fiber optic networks in 57 major U.S. metropolitan markets and plans to open eight additional markets by the end of 1997, representing nearly 70 percent of the nation's overall business telecommunications market.
The company is a leading alternative provider of local phone services to businesses in competition to the U.S. Regional Bell companies.
